subject: type-name
source_phrase: type-name shall be the name of an accessible derived type.

subject: module-name
source_phrase: If module-nature is INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of an intrinsic module.

subject: module-name
source_phrase: If module-nature is NON_INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of a nonintrinsic module.

subject: procedure-name
source_phrase: A procedure-name shall be a generic name or the name of a procedure.

subject: named-constant
source_phrase: Named constants in scalar-expr shall have been declared earlier in the scoping unit or made accessible by use

subject: dummy-arg-name-list
source_phrase: A given dummy-arg-name shall not appear more than once in a given dummy-arg-name-list.
